failure_modes.recovery: Pick another slug, or use the existing category.
failure_modes.when: a category with that slug already exists in this tenant

failure_modes.recovery: Slugs are lowercase identifiers: a-z, 0-9, '-' and '_'.

preconditions: is_default is server-owned (always 0 here) — defaults exist only via expense_category_ensure_defaults.

description: Adds a custom category to your tenant's category table — slug must be 1-50 chars of lowercase a-z, 0-9, '-' or '_' and unique per tenant (CONFLICT if taken). is_default is server-owned: supplying it at all refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR, and this door always creates with is_default 0 — the 9 seeded defaults exist only via expense_category_ensure_defaults. sort_order defaults to the next open slot when omitted.
name: expense_category_create
